저기.m: over there; um, excuse me (to get attention)
저기.x: The restroom is over there on the right.
저기.e: Same 이/그/저 pattern as 여기, 거기.
저기.t: 저기요! is the usual way to say 'Excuse me!' to a stranger or a waiter.

남편.forms: 남편이 · 남편을 · honorific: 남편분 (someone else's husband)
남편.x: My husband is an office worker.
남편.t: Talking about someone else's husband politely, say 남편분.

요리.e: 요리하다 = to cook; 한국 요리 = Korean cuisine.

취미.e: Literally 'interest-taste'. 취미가 뭐예요? = What's your hobby?
취미.t: Answer with 제 취미는 … 이에요/예요, or -는 것: 제 취미는 노래하는 거예요.

다시.forms: 다시 + verb: 다시 말해 주세요, 다시 만나요
다시.x: Please say it one more time.
다시.e: 다시 한번 = one more time; 다시 만나요 = see you again.
다시.t: 다시 = again (redo/repeat); 또 = again (another occurrence, often unwanted).

외모.ex: 저는 외모보다 성격이 더 중요하다고 생각해요.
외모.x: I think personality matters more than looks.

부산.ex: 서울에서 부산까지 KTX로 두 시간 반쯤 걸려요.
부산.x: It takes about two and a half hours from Seoul to Busan by KTX.
부산.e: Literally 'cauldron mountain', probably named after a pot-shaped hill.
부산.t: Busan's 해운대 (Haeundae) is Korea's most famous beach.

벨트.ex: 새로 산 바지가 좀 커서 벨트를 했어요.
벨트.x: My new pants were a little big, so I wore a belt.
벨트.e: From English 'belt'; the native word is 허리띠.

중학교.x: I was on the soccer team in middle school.

인사하다.m: to greet, to say hello; to bow
인사하다.x: I greeted my neighbor with a smile in the morning.
인사하다.e: Literally 'human affairs' — greeting as basic social manners.

자기소개.x: I introduced myself in Korean in the first class.
자기소개.t: Use with 하다: 자기소개를 하다; Koreans often start with 처음 뵙겠습니다 or 안녕하세요.

자신.x: Above all, it's important to believe in yourself.
자신.e: Literally 'self-body'; a different 자신 means 'confidence' (자신이 있다).

분야.x: What field do you want to work in someday?

대기.ex: 병원 대기 시간이 한 시간이나 됐어요.
대기.x: The wait at the hospital was a whole hour.
대기.t: A different 대기 means 'the atmosphere, air', as in 대기 오염 (air pollution).

대기.x: The air has been polluted by factory smoke.
대기.e: Literally 'great air'; don't confuse it with 대기 'waiting', a different word.
대기.t: In news, 대기 오염 (air pollution) and 대기 질 (air quality) are the most common collocations.

공통점.ex: 우리 둘은 공통점이 많아서 금방 친해졌어요.
공통점.x: We have a lot in common, so we became friends quickly.
공통점.e: Literally 'a point that runs through both'.

기부.ex: 매달 어린이 단체에 기부를 하고 있어요.
기부.x: I donate to a children's organization every month.
기부.e: Literally 'entrust and hand over' to others.

마치.m: as if, as though, just like
마치.x: That child talks just like an adult.
마치.e: Not related to 마치다 'to finish'; it's a separate word.
마치.t: 마치 almost always teams up with 처럼, 같다, or 듯이 later in the sentence.

관찰.x: Observing insects is a fun way for kids to learn.

위주.ex: 저는 요즘 채소 위주로 식사를 해요.
위주.x: These days I eat meals that are mostly vegetables.
위주.t: Almost always appears after a noun: 학생 위주의 수업 'a student-centered class'.

회계.x: My older sister does accounting work at her company.

질환.ex: 담배는 여러 가지 심장 질환의 원인이 됩니다.
질환.t: 질환 is formal and usually follows a body part: 심장 질환, 피부 질환.

전염.ex: 독감은 전염이 잘 되니까 마스크를 쓰세요.
전염.x: The flu spreads easily, so wear a mask.
전염.e: Literally 'pass on the stain' to others.

소매치기.x: I got pickpocketed on the subway and lost my wallet.
소매치기.e: Built from 소매 'sleeve' + 치기, a noun from 치다 'to strike.'
소매치기.t: Use 소매치기를 당하다 for 'to get pickpocketed.'

실험하다.ex: 우리는 과학 시간에 물과 소금으로 실험했어요.
실험하다.x: We did an experiment with water and salt in science class.
실험하다.e: Literally 'test for real': checking an idea in practice.

지연.ex: 날씨 때문에 비행기 출발이 두 시간 지연됐어요.
지연.x: Because of the weather, the flight's departure was delayed two hours.
지연.t: Used in airports and news; in everyday speech, people say 늦어지다.

지연.m: regional ties, bonds from a shared hometown
지연.ex: 선거 때마다 지연에 따라 표가 갈리는 경향이 있습니다.
지연.x: In every election, votes tend to split along regional ties.
지연.e: Literally 'land tie': bonds between people from the same hometown.
지연.t: Don't confuse it with its homonym 지연 'delay', as in 열차 지연 'train delay'.

전근.x: My husband is being transferred to Daegu.
전근.t: Students change schools with 전학; workers change offices with 전근.

저렴하다.ex: 이 식당은 음식이 맛있고 가격도 저렴해요.
저렴하다.x: This restaurant has tasty food and affordable prices.
저렴하다.t: 저렴하다 sounds more polite and positive than 싸다, which can imply poor quality.

비혼.ex: 요즘 비혼을 선택하는 젊은이들이 늘고 있어요.
비혼.x: More young people are choosing not to marry these days.
비혼.e: Literally 'not-marriage': a newer word framing singlehood as a choice.
비혼.t: 비혼 implies a deliberate choice, unlike 미혼 'not married yet'.

위염.ex: 요즘 스트레스 때문에 위염이 생긴 것 같아요.
위염.x: I think I've developed gastritis from stress lately.

민요.x: Arirang is the most famous folk song in Korea.

수질.ex: 이 강은 수질이 좋아서 물고기가 많아요.
수질.x: This river has good water quality, so there are lots of fish.

따분하다.x: I had nothing to do, so the weekend was boring.

비참하다.ex: 전쟁은 많은 사람에게 비참한 결과를 가져왔습니다.
비참하다.x: The war brought miserable consequences to many people.

실태.x: The government surveyed the actual state of youth unemployment.

면회.m: visit (to a soldier, patient or inmate)
면회.ex: 주말에 군대에 있는 동생 면회를 갔어요.
면회.x: On the weekend I went to visit my younger brother in the army.
면회.t: Used for visits to the army, a hospital or a prison. 면회 시간 = visiting hours.

무음.m: silent mode, mute (phone, notifications); no sound
무음.ex: 회의 중이라서 휴대폰을 무음으로 해 놨어요.
무음.x: I'm in a meeting, so I've put my phone on silent.
무음.t: A phone can be on 소리 'ring', 진동 'vibrate' or 무음 'silent'. Muting a noisy group chat: 알림을 끄다 or 채팅방을 무음으로 하다.

피선거권.m: eligibility for election, right to run for office
피선거권.x: In Korea, you can run for the National Assembly from age 18.
피선거권.e: Literally 'right to be elected'; 피- marks the passive, as in 피해.
피선거권.t: 선거권 is the right to vote; 피선거권 is the right to be voted for, that is, to run.

철폐.ex: 시민 단체들은 차별 제도의 철폐를 요구했습니다.
철폐.x: Civic groups demanded the abolition of discriminatory systems.
철폐.t: A strong protest word, as in 규제 철폐 (scrap regulations); 폐지 is the more neutral 'abolition'.

전과.ex: 그 남자는 이미 전과가 세 번이나 있었습니다.
전과.x: That man already had three previous convictions.
전과.e: Literally 'previous offense'; 과 here means a listed category of crime.
전과.t: Pronounced [전꽈]; 전과자 is the common word for 'ex-convict'.

징병제.ex: 한국은 징병제를 실시하고 있어서 남성은 군대에 가야 합니다.
징병제.x: Korea has conscription, so men must serve in the military.
징병제.e: Literally 'system of summoning soldiers'. -제 = system: 모병제, 대통령제.

배분하다.x: The government allocated the budget by region.
배분하다.e: Literally 'allot and divide'; the reverse order of 분배.
배분하다.t: 배분 stresses planned allocation of resources or time; 분배 stresses sharing results fairly.

매듭짓다.forms: 매듭지어요 · 매듭지었어요 · 매듭지을 거예요 · 매듭지으세요 (ㅅ irregular)
매듭짓다.m: to conclude, to wrap up, to settle
매듭짓다.ex: 오늘 회의에서 그 문제를 매듭지어야 합니다.
매듭짓다.x: We need to settle that issue in today's meeting.
매듭짓다.e: Built from 매듭 'knot' plus 짓다 'to make' — tying off the end.

어지간히.x: He must have been in a real hurry.
어지간히.t: Often ironic: 어지간히 하세요 means 'That's enough already!'

아전인수.m: self-serving interpretation, twisting things to one's own advantage
아전인수.ex: 그 정치인은 통계를 아전인수 격으로 해석했어요.
아전인수.x: That politician interpreted the statistics in a self-serving way.
아전인수.e: Literally 'drawing water into my own rice field'.

물꼬를 트다.forms: 물꼬를 터요 · 물꼬를 텄어요 · 물꼬가 트이다 (ㅡ drops)
물꼬를 트다.m: to open the way; to make a breakthrough
물꼬를 트다.ex: 두 나라 정상의 만남이 대화의 물꼬를 텄습니다.
물꼬를 트다.x: The meeting of the two leaders opened the way for dialogue.
물꼬를 트다.e: 물꼬 = a gap cut in a rice paddy's bank to let water flow in or out.

유교.ex: 한국 문화에는 아직도 유교의 영향이 많이 남아 있어요.
유교.x: A lot of Confucian influence still remains in Korean culture.
유교.e: Literally 'teaching of the scholars'. -교 = religion or teaching: 불교, 기독교.

원유.ex: 국제 원유 가격이 오르면서 기름값도 올랐어요.
원유.x: Gas prices went up as international crude oil prices rose.
원유.t: Homonym warning: 원유 (原乳) also means 'raw milk' in the dairy industry.

간염.ex: 간염은 예방 주사로 막을 수 있어요.
간염.x: Hepatitis can be prevented with a vaccine.
간염.e: Literally 'liver inflammation'. -염 = inflammation: 위염, 장염, 비염.
간염.t: Pronounced [가념]: the ㄴ links over to 염.

감정 노동.ex: 콜센터 직원들은 심한 감정 노동에 시달립니다.
감정 노동.x: Call center workers suffer from intense emotional labor.
감정 노동.e: A direct match of 'emotional labor'. 노동 = 'toil and move'.
감정 노동.t: Common in Korean social debates about service workers; often used with 시달리다 (to suffer from).

추모하다.m: to commemorate (the dead), to mourn and honor
추모하다.ex: 많은 시민들이 희생자들을 추모하기 위해 모였습니다.
추모하다.x: Many citizens gathered to commemorate the victims.
추모하다.e: Literally 'following and longing for' someone who has passed.

미련.m: lingering attachment, regret, not being able to let go
미련.ex: 헤어진 지 일 년이 지났는데 아직 미련이 남았어요.
미련.x: It's been a year since we broke up, but I still can't let go.
미련.e: Literally 'not yet refined', which doesn't help; learn it as 'can't let go'.
미련.t: Don't confuse with 미련하다 'to be foolish'; 미련이 남다 = to still be hung up on something.

주범.ex: 경찰은 이번 사건의 주범을 해외에서 검거했습니다.
주범.x: Police caught the mastermind of the case overseas.
주범.t: Often figurative in the news: 대기 오염의 주범 'the main culprit behind air pollution'.

면소.m: dismissal of prosecution (e.g., after the statute of limitations or an amnesty)
면소.ex: 공소시효가 지나 법원은 면소 판결을 내렸습니다.
면소.x: Because the statute of limitations had expired, the court dismissed the case.
면소.e: Literally 'released from the lawsuit' — ends the case without judging guilt.
면소.t: Unlike 무죄, 면소 doesn't declare innocence; the case simply can't go forward.

부결.m: rejection (of a bill or motion), voting down
부결.ex: 반대표가 많아서 결국 그 개정안이 부결되었습니다.
부결.x: With so many votes against it, the amendment was eventually voted down.

금수조치.ex: 정부는 그 나라에 대한 석유 금수조치를 발표했습니다.
금수조치.x: The government announced an oil embargo against that country.

초국적.forms: 초국적 + noun: 초국적 기업 · 초국적 자본
초국적.ex: 초국적 기업들이 세계 경제에 큰 영향을 미치고 있습니다.
초국적.x: Transnational corporations have a big influence on the world economy.
초국적.t: Pronounced [초국쩍]; 다국적 기업 is the more common everyday term.

핵확산.ex: 국제사회는 핵확산을 막기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.
핵확산.x: The international community is working to prevent nuclear proliferation.

선교.ex: 그는 아프리카에서 이십 년 동안 선교 활동을 했어요.
선교.x: He did missionary work in Africa for twenty years.
선교.t: 선교 is used mainly for Christianity; for Buddhism, 포교 is the usual word.

모세혈관.ex: 날씨가 추우면 피부 가까이에 있는 모세혈관이 수축합니다.
모세혈관.x: When the weather is cold, the capillaries near the skin contract.
모세혈관.e: Literally 'blood tubes as thin as hair'.

서체.ex: 발표 자료에는 읽기 쉬운 서체를 쓰는 게 좋아요.
서체.x: It's best to use an easy-to-read font in presentation slides.
서체.e: Literally 'writing style'; covers both brush styles and computer fonts.
서체.t: For a person's own handwriting, use 필체 or 글씨체; 서체 leans toward designed styles and fonts.

수탈.ex: 일제는 토지 조사 사업으로 농민들의 땅을 수탈했어요.
수탈.x: Imperial Japan seized farmers' land through the land survey project.

비호하다.m: to shield, to protect (often wrongly), to cover for
비호하다.ex: 그 정치인은 비리 공무원을 비호했다는 의혹을 받았습니다.
비호하다.x: The politician was suspected of covering for a corrupt official.
비호하다.t: Usually negative: shielding someone who doesn't deserve protection.

회귀하다.m: to return (to an origin), to revert
회귀하다.ex: 연어는 알을 낳기 위해 태어난 강으로 회귀합니다.
회귀하다.x: Salmon return to the river where they were born to lay eggs.
회귀하다.e: Literally 'turn and go home' — like salmon heading upstream.

훼손하다.m: to damage, to deface; to defame (reputation)
훼손하다.ex: 문화재를 훼손하면 법에 따라 처벌을 받습니다.
훼손하다.x: Damaging cultural heritage is punishable by law.
훼손하다.t: 명예를 훼손하다 'to defame' — 명예 훼손 is the legal term for defamation.

피폐하다.x: People's lives were devastated by the long war.

오묘하다.x: The workings of nature are truly profound and mysterious.

애잔하다.x: The poignant violin melody moved my heart.
애잔하다.e: Probably linked to 애 'heart, anxious feeling', as in 애타다 and 애틋하다.

바투.forms: 바투 + verb: 바투 앉다 · 바투 다가서다 · 날짜를 바투 잡다
바투.ex: 의자를 책상 쪽으로 바투 당겨 앉으세요.
바투.x: Pull your chair in close to the desk and sit down.
바투.t: With time it means 'tight, soon': 결혼 날짜를 바투 잡았어요 'They set an early wedding date.'

잔재.x: We must clear away the remnants of the Japanese colonial period.
잔재.t: Usually negative; a common collocation is 잔재를 청산하다, 'to clear away the vestiges.'
